Our Story

A home kitchen with a wide table.

The Bakey Bay is a home-based food business serving Narowal, Punjab. The menu runs from desi karahi to Asian wok dishes, pasta, pizza, burgers, dumplings and sweet treats — all prepared at home and delivered to you.
